_why: The switches the nightly watches (Legal RL-208, 2026-10-30). Legal's open rows RL-177, RL-179, RL-180 and RL-183 (the energy kits, rapid fire, snares and mines, grab call-outs, rally links) apply only to content that is ON in the exported build: for any that is ON, the row's own clips join the batch (flash register, three white bursts a second, the rally cap); for any that is OFF the row stays open and reopens on the day it is switched on. tools/flash/nightly-seeds.mjs reads each rule in the PINNED commit's own exported tree, prints the state in the night's build info line and fails the night (exit 5) when a switch is not as it was reviewed. A rule is { flag: { file, path } } (a boolean in a data file: true is on, false is off, missing is absent), { files: [globs] } (a file of that name in the tree means the content landed: on; none: absent), { any: [rules] } or { none: why } (no switch exists in this tree yet: absent). 'absent' counts as off. 'expected' is the state Legal reviewed. A new hook is one edit here, made when Combat or Narrative lands it; until then a switch with no hook is only watched by its files.
